def nonlinear(p, key):
    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
    u = p['u']
    v = p[key]
    best = None
    for variant in ['shared', 'separate', 'shift']:
        k = 1 if variant == 'shared' else 4

        def design(q, r):
            w = q * r[:k] + (r[k:] if len(r) > k else 0)
            return np.c_[np.ones(len(q)), q, np.tanh(w) if key == 'v1' else 1 / (1 + w * w)]

        def err(r):
            D = design(u, r)
            return (D @ np.linalg.lstsq(D, v, rcond=None)[0] - v).ravel()
        r0 = np.r_[np.full(k, 2.2 if key == 'v1' else 0.4), np.zeros(4 if variant == 'shift' else 0)]
        opt = least_squares(err, r0, bounds=(np.r_[np.full(k, 0.05), np.full(len(r0) - k, -2)], np.r_[np.full(k, 5), np.full(len(r0) - k, 2)]), max_nfev=120)
        D = design(u, opt.x)
        c = np.linalg.lstsq(D, v, rcond=None)[0]
        score = np.mean(abs(err(opt.x)))
        print(key, variant, score, opt.x)
        if best is None or score < best[0] * 0.65:
            best = (score, opt.x, c, design)
    (score, r, c, d) = best
    return lambda q: d(q, r) @ c

def affine(p, k='v'):
    d = np.c_[np.ones(len(p['u'])), p['u']]
    v = p[k]
    keep = np.ones(len(d), bool)
    for _ in range(5):
        f = np.linalg.lstsq(d[keep], v[keep], rcond=None)[0]
        r = np.linalg.norm(v - d @ f, axis=1)
        keep = r < max(0.001, 3 * np.median(r))
    return f

def pred(K, D, g, a, b):
    from scipy.linalg import cho_factor
    from scipy.linalg import cho_solve
    w = cho_solve(cho_factor(K[np.ix_(a, a)]), np.c_[D[a], g[a]])
    W = w[:, :D.shape[1]]
    G = w[:, -1]
    c = np.linalg.lstsq(D[a].T @ W, D[a].T @ G, rcond=1e-10)[0]
    return D[b] @ c + K[np.ix_(b, a)] @ (G - W @ c)

def fit(q, t, r, mode, trend, kind, details=False):
    from scipy.spatial.distance import cdist
    from scipy.linalg import cho_solve
    from scipy.linalg import cholesky
    from scipy.optimize import minimize
    L = np.c_[np.ones(len(q)), q]
    D = poly(q, trend)
    (n, p) = q.shape
    iu = np.tril_indices(p, -1)
    delta = q[:, None, :] - q[None, :, :]
    outer = delta[:, :, :, None] * delta[:, :, None, :]
    eye = np.eye(n)

    def metric(a):
        E = np.diag(np.exp(a[:p]))
        if mode == 'full':
            E[iu] = a[p:-2]
        return E

    def cov(d, a):
        if kind == 'rbf':
            return (np.exp(-d / 2), -0.5 * np.exp(-d / 2))
        d = np.sqrt(np.maximum(5 * d, 1e-24))
        return ((1 + d + d * d / 3) * np.exp(-d), -5 / 6 * (1 + d) * np.exp(-d))

    def calc(a):
        E = metric(a)
        d = np.einsum('abij,ij->ab', outer, E @ E.T)
        (C, g) = cov(d, a)
        R = np.exp(a[-1])
        V = np.exp(a[-2])
        Q = V * C + R * eye
        F = cholesky(Q, lower=True)
        w = cho_solve((F, True), np.c_[D, t])
        W = w[:, :D.shape[1]]
        T = D.T @ W
        J = cholesky(T, lower=True)
        b = cho_solve((J, True), D.T @ w[:, -1])
        al = w[:, -1] - W @ b
        G = cho_solve((F, True), eye) - W @ cho_solve((J, True), W.T) - np.outer(al, al)
        H = np.einsum('ab,abij->ij', G * g * V, outer) @ E
        H0 = np.diag(H) * np.exp(a[:p])
        grad = np.r_[H0, H[iu] if mode == 'full' else [], 0.5 * V * np.sum(G * C), 0.5 * R * np.trace(G)]
        return (np.log(F.diagonal()).sum() + np.log(J.diagonal()).sum() + 0.5 * (t - D @ b) @ al, grad, b, al)
    a0 = np.r_[np.full(p, -0.6), np.zeros(len(iu[0]) if mode == 'full' else 0), -2.5, -8.8]
    bd = [(-3, 2)] * p + [(-3, 3)] * (len(a0) - p - 2) + [(-10, 2), (-13, -4)]
    opt = minimize(lambda a: calc(a)[:2], a0, jac=True, method='L-BFGS-B', bounds=bd, options={'maxiter': 120})
    a = opt.x
    (_, _, b, al) = calc(a)
    E = metric(a)
    d = cdist(r @ E, q @ E, 'sqeuclidean')
    pred = poly(r, trend) @ b + np.exp(a[-2]) * cov(d, a)[0] @ al
    return (pred, a) if details else pred
